author: Mark Atwood
text: Design refinement during implementation: instead of adding lichen_key_store_get_by_addr to coap_keys_store.c, use the existing lichen_key_store_list() enumeration from coap_server.c sos_post (mirrors the Rust pinned_pubkey_for_addr pattern landed in a348cba56e). Rationale: coap_keys_store.c is compiled standalone by lichen/tests/coap_keys_lifecycle WITHOUT the link module, so a store-level call to lichen_identity_ygg_addr_from_ed25519 would break that host link; a server-side lookup adds no new dependency and no test churn. Store untouched; same -ENOENT semantics.
